headline: UK proposes 14-year sentences for undersea cable sabotage amid Russia fears
summary: The UK government outlined plans for up to 14-year prison sentences, new criminal offenses and new powers over telecoms operators to protect undersea cables in UK waters, citing concerns about Russian interference.

claims.statement: The UK government proposed up to 14-year prison sentences for undersea cable saboteurs amid fears of Russian interference.
